newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mixed Friday, with gold and silver seen firm but platinum group metals seen easing, after Thursday's gains, traders said.
Overnight, Russian Finance Minister Chubais announced the deregulation of the Russian gold market.
Currently, the Russian government maintains tight control over the production and marketing of precious metals. Russia is believed to have produced about 122 tonnes of gold in 1996.
COMEX June was gold called unchanged to up $0.20 from Thursday's close of $344.30 an ounce.
